changelog:
The live wall toolbar has a button that switches every camera between SD and HD at once.
The Switch site menu shows whether each site is online.
Alerts and recordings appear sooner on the playback timeline.
Deleting an API key now also cuts off the live video and alert connections it opened.
Turning off remote access while connected remotely now finishes the unlink.
A recorder that's no longer linked stops sending phone notifications.
Signing out from a recorder now removes saved backup keys from the browser.
